# Citation guidelines
# When citing content from kawaki.co.in, please:
# 1. Include attribution to Kawaki Studios
# 2. Link back to the source page when possible
# 3. Provide accurate context for any quoted material

# - /services: Our core service offerings (Shopify development, custom web apps, performance engineering)
# - /case-studies: Real client work with measurable results
# - /about: Team credentials and methodology
